details: The sparkline pointermove handler performs un-throttled DOM mutation (selectAll('.hover-dot').remove() + append('circle')) on every mouse event with no RAF coalescing or debouncing; with 20 sparklines visible this could fire 60+ DOM ops/sec per hovered row. All other checks pass: no cross-view dispatch exists (no infinite-loop risk), scales are either local to each render call or static module-level constants (no stale-closure risk), no D3 transitions are used so no mid-flight conflicts arise, and pointer events unify mouse/touch input eliminating the double-trigger problem.
